name: BTC24H
fix_description: In claim, the function transfers tokens to msg.sender without verifying the caller is the intended beneficiary. Only checks time (onlyOnOrAfter) and not-yet-claimed, but anyone can call it and receive the locked tokens. Fix: add require(msg.sender == beneficiary) to restrict who can claim.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit: call the vulnerable contract's claim() once, then swap the improperly obtained tokens twice through a router. It involves minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no flash loans or complex state manipulation, and fits a straightforward missing-validation/access-control style bug.
